diagnosis: Customer rotated IdP signing certificate, resulting in assertion errors. This matches the symptoms of a metadata mismatch described in kb-0006.
reply: I am sorry to hear that your users are experiencing assertion errors when signing in via SSO. Based on the certificate rotation you mentioned, this issue is often caused by a metadata mismatch. Please refer to our knowledge base article kb-0006, "SSO metadata mismatch after an identity provider change," which recommends re-uploading the metadata and testing with a single account before re-enabling enforcement.
